# Skill 1 — Memo Approval Assistant

A Claude Code **skill**. When a broker or buyer requests a memo hold on a diamond, the HITL gate auto-decides AUTO_APPROVE / NEEDS_REVIEW / AUTO_REJECT using first-come (FIFO) allocation plus two guardrails — so the desk no longer hand-picks who receives a stone.

## Layout

```
skills/memo-approval/
├── SKILL.md                  # skill — frontmatter + instructions Claude reads
├── scripts/
│   └── memo_approval.py      # decision engine + CLI
├── install.sh                # copies skill into .claude/skills/ to activate
└── README.qmd                # this file
```

## Activate it

```bash
bash skills/memo-approval/install.sh
```

Restart Claude Code (or open a new session) to activate.

## Using it through Claude

> "Review all pending memo requests."
> "Who gets stone LGSTK00279?"
> "What memos still need my manual review?"
> "Which memos auto-rejected today?"

## Running the script directly

```bash
source .venv/bin/activate

# Single memo decision
uv run python skills/memo-approval/scripts/memo_approval.py --memo MEMO00001

# All pending memos (FIFO auto-decision)
uv run python skills/memo-approval/scripts/memo_approval.py --all-pending

# With LLM narration for the review/reject cases
uv run python skills/memo-approval/scripts/memo_approval.py \
    --all-pending --model api-llama-4-scout

# JSON output
uv run python skills/memo-approval/scripts/memo_approval.py --all-pending --json
```

## Decision rules (precedence order)

| # | Condition | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Requester already received this stone on a prior memo | **AUTO_REJECT** |
| 2 | Mid-CLV customer (`Gold` tier) requesting >1 stone at once | **NEEDS_REVIEW** |
| 3 | Earliest pending request for the stone (FIFO winner) | **AUTO_APPROVE** |
| 4 | Stone already allocated to an earlier request (FIFO loser) | **AUTO_REJECT** |

- **FIFO order** is keyed on the (now timestamped) `request_date`, simulating
  requests arriving over time.
- **Mid CLV** = the `Gold` `clv_tier` (configurable via `MID_CLV_TIERS`).
  `NEEDS_REVIEW` is the only case left for a human.

## Tests

```bash
uv run pytest tests/skills/test_memo_approval.py -v
```

21 tests covering `build_received_pairs`, `multi_request_customers`, `decide_memo`, `review_pending`, the three decision paths (FIFO / review / already-received), formatting, and CLI.
